short_scenes.caption: The sky cracked open.
short_scenes.narration: That night, the sky cracked open. Thunder. Lightning. Rain like falling rivers.

short_scenes.caption: The fire was dying.
short_scenes.narration: Their only fire began to die. Without it, wolves would come. Without it, the cold would kill them.

short_scenes.caption: She shielded it with her body.
short_scenes.narration: Mia wrapped her body around the last glowing ember, shielding it from the wind and the rain, all night long.

short_scenes.caption: Then they heard howling.
short_scenes.narration: Then, through the storm, they heard it. Howling. Getting closer.
